name: usb-cdc
description: USB 2.0 Full-Speed (12 Mbit/s) Communications Device Class (CDC) core. Multi-channel, byte-stream interface with valid/ready handshakes. Written in pure Verilog; FPGA-validated on Fomu and TinyFPGA-BX. The CDC class provides USB-serial-port-style host communication.

interfaces.description: System clock (Full-Speed USB requires 48 MHz reference)
USB differential pair (D+/D-) at Full-Speed 12 Mbit/s; needs external USB transceiver or analog buffer for I/O
Per-channel TX byte stream from device to host
Per-channel RX byte stream from host to device

asic.notes: RTL-only upstream. Integration into a Caravel SoC needs a Vyges-original TL-UL/Wishbone wrapper IP for register-mapped access — planned as a separate catalog entry.

notes: Mirror of github.com/ulixxe/usb_cdc. Complements opentitan-usbdev (device-mode controller without CDC class). CDC is the canonical USB class for /dev/ttyUSB0-style serial communication.
